target_customer: Individuals and professional teams who save and share links; Pro accounts at $25 per year
problem: Sharing useful links through email and wikis was clumsy and bookmarking tools were solitary. Kippt wanted to be a GitHub for links, a collaborative bookmarking system.
business_model: Freemium bookmarking with a $25 per year Pro plan; later a team product called Inc

founders.name: Karri Saarinen
founders.background_notes: YC profile lists later roles at Airbnb and Coinbase and later co-founding Linear; TechCrunch calls both founders Finnish designers.

founders.name: Jori Lallo
previous_startups: Convore (worked on it, YC backed message board)
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch says Lallo worked on Convore with Leah Culver while Kippt was a side project.

exit.reason: Acquihire of the Kippt and Inc team; the team said Kippt had not grown enough to be sustainable. Services were kept running until a shutdown on 2015-09-06 per Buffer.

competitors.name: Delicious
competitors.what: Social bookmarking service called a nominal competitor by TechCrunch

competitors.name: Pinboard
competitors.what: Paid bookmarking service named alongside Kippt

competitors.name: Evernote
competitors.what: Note and web clipping tool called a nominal competitor by TechCrunch

technical_complexity.rationale: A web app with browser extensions and a later API and app gallery; standard engineering for two developers and designers.

defensibility.rationale: Saved links create some lock in, and the design was praised, but Pocket, Pinboard and Evernote could add sharing easily.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pocket added Kippt support in 2012 rather than copying it; Coinbase hired the team in May 2014 and Kippt shut on 2015-09-06 per Buffer.

market_need_then: TechCrunch said the founders saw email and wikis as the real competitor for sharing links, and coverage in 2012 and 2013 from TechCrunch, TNW and ReadWrite showed interest from early adopters. No user counts were found.

branding.domain_note: Used kippt.com, not exact match risk; purchase history not found. The domain returned HTTP 503 when fetched.

identity.visual_style: Minimal, design led interface by two designers
identity.voice_and_tone: Pitched as GitHub for links and a medium between Instapaper and heavy bookmarking tools

branding.community_and_virality: Integrations with Buffer and Pocket and an API app gallery in 2013; design blog swiss-miss covered it in July 2012.

brand_strength.rationale: Good design press and developer integrations, and the team was later hired by Coinbase partly for design and branding work, but no wide consumer recognition.

pivots.to: Inc, a team tool for sharing useful content
pivots.why: TechCrunch reported Kippt Inc leaving beta in October 2013 aimed at workplaces; the YC page also describes professional networks

outcome_analysis: Kippt was a well designed bookmarking app by two Finnish designers that got YC funding and good press but did not grow enough to be sustainable, per the team. Coinbase hired the team in May 2014 as an acquihire with undisclosed terms, and Kippt closed in September 2015. The outcome was a soft landing for the founders, one of whom later co-founded Linear.
notes: The $20K 2012 round rests on CB Insights alone; no primary announcement. The YC directory says Inactive while the exit is an acquihire; the acquisition terms were not disclosed. The September 2015 shutdown date comes from a Buffer partner page. kippt.com returned 503 on fetch. Karri Saarinen's education was not found.
